then.description: Add this oath to your Oaths of Conviction as well:
pick: Castigation (Never allow an evildoer to live). When you **Trade Blows** with a creature with evil intent (GM's call), add +1d6 **holy** dmg

else.description:
Gain the **Oaths of Conviction - Liege** Paladin Starting Move: you have sworn a righteous oath and service to a liege; name them now: ___inq1pln:leader/institution/organization__.

You start with the oath below marked. As long as you uphold it, you can use its benefit:
pick: Castigation (Never allow an evildoer to live). When you **Trade Blows** with a creature with evil intent (GM's call), add +1d6 **holy** dmg

submoves.title: Broken Oaths
submoves.description: When you **break an oath** (your call), clear that oath and lock a Condition. When you **find a way to atone** (also your call), clear a Condition and mark a cleared oath.

submoves.title: Smite Evil
submoves.description: When you **Trade Blows** with a creature with evil intent,

outcomes.text: Add the following to the list of options available:
bullets: If they're an outsider to this world, you banish them for a while
You mark their appearance permanently; describe how
You weaken their resolve; the GM will say what happens

title: By the Power Invested in Me…
description: When you **give an NPC an order based on your authority**, roll+STR.

outcomes.text: They follow your order and you get **adv** to your next Move rolled against them.

bullets: Do as you say, but tell someone about it afterwards

outcomes.text: They dismiss your authority; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Mystical Imprisonment
description: When you **name an evildoer and order them to stop**, magical chains appear and bind them; roll+STR.

bullets: It lasts longer than a few moments
They can't speak or cast spells

outcomes.text: The chains can't hold them; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Nomosmancy
description: You can **Cast a Spell**+STR to impose Order and deny a supernatural effect.

bullets: You get a supernatural stain; you can't use this Move until you **Make Camp**

title: Public Condemnation
description: When you **proclaim someone to be an evildoer to the public**, roll+STR.

outcomes.text: Choose two from the list below.
bullets: They will hunt the evildoer down for you as a group
They will protect you from the evildoer
You impress someone powerful (GM's call); roll with **adv** the next time you **Pull Strings** on them

outcomes.text: An evildoer is hidden among the crowd; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.
